mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_copy WHERE barcode=#{barcode} AND id != #{excludeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE book_copy barcode=#{request.barcode}, call_number=#{request.callNumber}, location=#{request.location}, status=#{request.status}, acquired_at=#{request.acquiredAt}, price=#{request.price}, condition_note=#{request.conditionNote},version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{request.expectedVersion}
UPDATE book_copy SET status='DISCARDED', version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status NOT IN ('BORROWED','RESERVED','DISCARDED')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM book_copy WHERE book_id=#{bookId} AND status='AVAILABLE' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE book_copy SET status='BORROWED',version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND book_id=#{bookId} AND status='AVAILABLE' AND version=#{version}
update book_copy set status = #{status}, condition_note = #{conditionNote}, version = version + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp(3) where id = #{id} and status = 'BORROWED' and version = #{version}
